title: Controlled OpenClaw upgrade to stable
description: Perform a supervised OpenClaw stable-channel upgrade using the built-in staged updater. Preserve and verify the existing state backup, record pre-upgrade versions/status, run the update non-interactively with JSON output, then verify CLI version, Gateway status, loopback readiness on port 18789, RPC health and Scheduled Task status. If verification fails, rollback restores the backed-up OpenClaw state and attempts to repair/restart the Gateway with the previously installed package version.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $BackupRoot=Join-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\018c' $stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BackupRoot | Out-Null; Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-018c-current.txt' -Value $BackupRoot -Encoding UTF8; $state=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $state){$dest=Join-Path $BackupRoot 'openclaw-state'; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $state -Destination $dest -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('OPENCLAW_STATE_BACKUP='+$dest)}; $preVer=(& openclaw --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim(); Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $BackupRoot 'pre-version.txt') -Value $preVer -Encoding UTF8; try{$preStatus=(& openclaw gateway status --json 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 500); Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $BackupRoot 'pre-gateway-status.json.txt') -Value $preStatus -Encoding UTF8}catch{}; Write-Host ('PRE_VERSION='+$preVer); Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$BackupRoot); Write-Host 'BACKUP_018C_READY'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $report=Join-Path $root 'openclaw-upgrade-018c.txt'; $out=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; function A([string]$s){$out.Add($s); Write-Host $s}; function Run([string]$label,[scriptblock]$cmd){A ('--- '+$label+' ---'); $r=(& $cmd 2>&1 | Out-String -Width 500).Trim(); if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($r)){A 'NO_OUTPUT'}else{foreach($line in @($r -split '\r?\n')){A ([string]$line)}}; return $r}; A '=== OPENCLAW CONTROLLED UPGRADE 018C ==='; A ('TIMESTAMP='+([DateTime]::Now.ToString('o'))); $pre=((& openclaw --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()); A ('PRE_VERSION='+$pre); $latest=((& npm view openclaw version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim().Trim('
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $report='C:\3EN-Agent\openclaw-upgrade-018c.txt'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $report)){throw 'Upgrade report missing'}; $c=Get-Content -LiteralPath $report -Raw; foreach($m in @('OPENCLAW CONTROLLED UPGRADE 018C','UPDATE START','POST_VERSION=','READYZ_HTTP=200','PORT_18789_LISTENING=TRUE','OPENCLAW_UPGRADE_018C=PASS')){if($c -notmatch [regex]::Escape($m)){throw ('Missing marker: '+$m)}}; Write-Host ('REPORT_SIZE='+(Get-Item -LiteralPath $report).Length); Write-Host 'VALIDATION_018C=PASS'
rollback: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $b=(Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-018c-current.txt' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Trim(); Write-Host ('ROLLBACK_BACKUP='+$b); $preFile=Join-Path $b 'pre-version.txt'; $pre=''; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $preFile){$pre=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $preFile -Raw).Trim()}; $m=[regex]::Match($pre,'(?<v>\d{4}\.\d+\.\d+(?:-\d+)?)'); if($m.Success){$v=$m.Groups['v'].Value; Write-Host ('ROLLBACK_PACKAGE_VERSION='+$v); try{openclaw gateway stop | Out-Host}catch{}; try{npm install -g ('openclaw@'+$v) --allow-scripts=openclaw | Out-Host}catch{Write-Warning $_.Exception.Message}}else{Write-Warning 'Could not determine previous OpenClaw package version'}; $stateSrc=Join-Path $b 'openclaw-state'; $stateDst=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $stateSrc){try{if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $stateDst){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stateDst -Recurse -Force}; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $stateSrc -Destination $stateDst -Recurse -Force; Write-Host 'STATE_RESTORED=TRUE'}catch{Write-Warning $_.Exception.Message}}; try{openclaw gateway install --force | Out-Host}catch{}; try{openclaw gateway restart | Out-Host}catch{}; try{openclaw gateway status --json | Out-Host}catch{}; Write-Host 'ROLLBACK_018C_ATTEMPT_COMPLETE'
